resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups' | project id, name, location
query.description: KQL over Resource Graph tables (resources, resourcecontainers, healthresources, …). Default: resources | project id, name, type, location, resourceGroup, tags

id.description: A resource ID from a query: that resource's snapshot instead of a query.

subscription.description: One of the connection's subscription IDs. Default: all of them.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous call with the same arguments.
